hens_rule_text: chickens are not permitted within city limits; poultry counts as a domestic farm animal, which may not be kept unless approved by the Department of Planning Services
permit_notes: Code 91.019 bars domestic farm animals unless approved by the Department of Planning Services; the city FAQ simply says chickens are not permitted in city limits. No residential hen permit exists.
setback_notes: Not applicable, chickens are not allowed on ordinary residential lots.
zoning_notes: City Council rejected an urban chicken ordinance (up to 5 hens, no roosters) in a 2 to 7 vote in December 2023, the third failed attempt. No later change found as of September 2026.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

research_notes: Read the official City Council FAQ directly, which states chickens are not permitted in city limits. Code 91.019 wording (poultry is a domestic farm animal, not allowed unless approved by Planning Services) came from search extracts; the Planning approval path is unclear and likely limited to agricultural zoning.
